notes.title: Typo fix, Quit key change
notes.content:
Very small update:

[olist]
[*] Fixed a typo during the scene where MC is installing mouldings
[*] Re-mapped the Quit key from F12 to F10
[/olist]
As to the latter, one of our Patreon backers pointed out that F12 is the default Steam client key for creating screen snaps, and thus, all of his screen snaps had the "Are you sure?" dialog in the middle of the screen. As such, we have moved that to F10 to remove this conflict.

Thanks!

-Doc62

notes.title: Release is almost upon us!
notes.content:
Great news!

The Steam admins have reviewed [i]Mistress Marigold's Home Improvement[/i] and have more or less approved the release candidate build submitted for review!

Their one concern, however, is that we have a few issues related to the non-English translations of the game. That is a fair criticism. If you are a member of our Discord community, you are already aware of this and why it is so: all of our translations are machine-generated, and as such, far from perfect.

Even so, we feel like at least attempting to release our titles with support for languages other than English opens up our titles to a far larger community. Like some other AVN creators that do this, our hope is that some of our fans will decide they like what we're doing enough to volunteer to help clean up some of this imperfect use of their native language.

If English is not your first language and you have an opinion on our approach to this, I would very much appreciate any thoughts you are willing to share.

Please try to be constructive - we're doing the best we can. 😁

-Doc62
